record.scope: New application, unchanged complete native/build inputs and retained original binary/receipts. This is input equivalence, not a build at the new application commit and not inherited gameplay qualification.

environment.timing_scope: Serial matched local Linux llvmpipe; all mission compilation/native/graphical tests stopped for this comparison. Explicit unavailable local desktop bus identical everyarm.
environment.prior_failure_disposition: No timing arms ran. Strict child ownership correctly detected DISPLAY-triggered dbus-launch zombie. Exact stat/status retained; explicit unavailable bus passed original import and graphical ownership gates with no predicate changes.

measurement_scope: Serial same-host Linux Xorg/llvmpipe 0/1/1/0, whole original frozenV3 physical and source gates. First144 completed real steps are the prospective comparison window; Wave512 runs continue to minimum10sec. No sustained owner-device acceptance. Whole-process CPU includes scene setup and capture and is not aligned to Godot capture clocks.

physical_outcome_parity.disposition: Same-source equal-step body and admitted-move outcomes agree; cross-source outcomes are disclosed, not assumed.
physical_outcome_parity.scope: Different-source speed deltas are whole-source comparisons. Identical initial workload alone does not establish identical physical outcomes. Repeated input admission counts remain explicit and can differ with cadence.

whole_process_cpu.scope: Actual owned Godot process CPU accounting, all its threads. Includes scene setup and capture inside the sampled process lifetime. Samples are not aligned to Godot capture clocks. The unobserved launch/exit tail is excluded from interval deltas; last cumulative counters are lower bounds on lifetime CPU. Read time for successful and failed queries is external sampler wall cost, not Godot CPU; elapsed_ms marks query request, not an instantaneous kernel accounting timestamp. No GPU busy-time or hardware utilization claim.
